result.description: Low-code cloud database/spreadsheet hybrid platform for building apps, workflows and automations on structured data.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 (registered integration at /create/oauth) for third-party apps acting for other users; personal access tokens (Bearer) for own/single-account use. Legacy API keys dead since 2024-02-01.
result.access_detail: Anyone can register an OAuth integration or create a PAT self-serve. Only requirement before other users can authorize: privacy policy and ToS URLs. No app review found in the docs. Some admin/enterprise endpoints are Enterprise-only.
result.api_notes: REST/JSON covers records CRUD, bases and tables and fields schema, webhooks, comments, attachments, collaborators and enterprise admin endpoints. Rate limit 5 req/s per base. Official JS client airtable.js.

evidence.quote: We currently support using personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens during the authentication process.
Any integrations that allow other users to grant access to Airtable should use OAuth.
You can access the OAuth integrations panel at [/create/oauth](https://airtable.com/create/oauth).
Most properties are optional, but note that the Privacy policy URL and Terms of service URL must be provided before sharing your
The API is limited to 5 requests per second per base.
The server is available to all users on all plans.
The Airtable API can be used to integrate your data in Airtable with any external system.
